title: Marisol
meta_description: Find the perfect 30A, FL vacation rental at ‘Marisol’ a Luxury 7 Bedroom, 7.5 Bathroom vacation rental. Ideal for 18 guests, this home offers a private pool, rooftop terrace & 6-seater golf cart.
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: • 6 Bedrooms • 7.5 Full Bathrooms • Sleeps 20 • Unobstructed Gulf Views • Rooftop Terrace with Unparalleled Coastal Views • Heated Private Pool with Summer Kitchen (Pool can be heated for an additional $40 per day from October 1 - May 1) • 4 Stories & 5,616 Square Feet • 6 Seater Golf Cart & 6 Adult Bikes Included • 2 Beach Accesses • Elevator • Parking for 3 Vehicles Welcome to Marisol – where luxury meets the Gulf Coast's natural beauty in a four-story retreat designed for unforgettable beach getaways. Nestled in the heart of Inlet Beach, this exquisite home blends modern elegance with timeless coastal charm. Its prime location offers effortless access to upscale shopping and dining at 30Avenue, as well as the iconic communities of Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach, ensuring an unparalleled experience of coastal living. With six bedrooms and seven and a half bathrooms, Marisol accommodates up to 20 guests, providing both comfort and privacy for all. Spanning 5,616 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space, this home offers plenty of room for gathering, unwinding, and making memories. Soak in the stunning, unobstructed Gulf views from nearly every angle, offering the perfect setting for tranquil mornings or vibrant sunsets. The gourmet kitchen, equipped with top-of-the-line appliances, is a chef’s delight and opens seamlessly into the spacious living area overlooking the turquoise waters. This inviting space is ideal for relaxation or entertaining. For the ultimate retreat, head to the rooftop terrace, where panoramic views of emerald waters and sugar-white sands take center stage. Step outside to your own heated private pool, an oasis perfect for year-round enjoyment. A six-seater golf cart and six adult bikes make exploring Inlet Beach effortless, while direct community beach access ensures the sugar-white sands and Gulf waters are just moments away. The home’s elevator provides convenience, making every floor accessible to guests of all ages. At Marisol, every detail has been thoughtfully curated to provide a luxurious and relaxing experience. Whether you’re lounging by the pool, enjoying the rooftop views, or strolling to the beach, every moment here is crafted for comfort and connection. Perfect for family gatherings, reunions, or group vacations, Marisol is more than just a home – it’s the ultimate coastal escape. Book your stay at Marisol and discover the unmatched beauty and charm of Inlet Beach – the Gulf Coast’s hidden gem. Sleeping Arrangement First Floor - Bunk Area w/ Two Queen over Queen Bunks, Shared Bathroom w/ Shower/Tub Combo - King Bedroom, Private Bathroom w/ Shower Only Second Floor - 1/2 Bathroom - King Bedroom, Private Bathroom w/ Shower Only Third Floor - Master King Bedroom, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate - Queen Bedroom, Private Bathroom with/ Shower Only - King Bedroom, Private Bathroom w/ Shower Only - Office Bedroom w/ Sleeper Sofa, Private Bathroom w/ Shower Only **Indoor fireplace not for guest use**
